jurisdiction: North Lebanon Township, Lebanon County, PA
sourceTitle: North Lebanon Township Zoning Map (adopted 4/17/2023, printed 6/2/2023; prepared by the Lebanon City Authority / County GIS Department)
method: The PDF was rendered at 300 dpi; district fill colours were classified per pixel, linework and labels were filled from their neighbours, and district outlines were traced and simplified (5 ft tolerance). The raster was georeferenced by matching the Industrial district at 1625 Heilmandale Rd to the county tax parcel (best fit 3.330 ft per pixel, overlap 95.8%).
accuracyNote: Approximate: about +/- 10 ft plus the map's own generalization. The map states that boundaries shown along roads follow the road centerlines and that the Zoning Hearing Board decides any uncertainty. Only the window around 1625 Heilmandale Rd was digitized; polygons are cut off at the window edge.
